N4571A-27-R-0002 Page 13 of 106 Truth-seeking means the LLM is truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information or analysis. The LLM prioritizes historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity, and acknowledges uncertainty where reliable information is incomplete or contradictory. Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. Significant Modifications means any changes made by the contractor or subcontractor to the AI model that could reasonably be expected to alter its adherence to the Unbiased AI Principles. For the purposes of compliance with the Unbiased AI Principles, this definition includes, but is not limited to, changes to training data and model architecture, and alterations to filtering and content moderation. (b) Contractor Obligation. The contractor must ensure that any LLM or other AI model provided under this contract complies with the Unbiased AI Principles throughout the period of performance. OCSP OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) on viis, kuidas kontrollida kas veebilehe turvasertifikaat on endiselt kehtiv. HTTP Veebilehe andmeedastusprotokoll, mis ei kasuta krüpteerimist. HTTPS Turvaline versioon HTTP protokollist. HTTPS kasutab SSL/TLS protokolle, et tagada andmete turvaline edastus veebilehe ja kasutaja vahel. See kaitseb kasutaja andmeid pealtkuulamise ja muutmise eest. SSL/TLS Turvaprotokollid andmeedastuse krüpteerimiseks. SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) ja TLS (Transport Layer Security) loovad turvalise krüpteeritud kanali veebibrauseri ja veebiserveri vahel. TLS on uuem ja turvalisem versioon SSL-ist. Turvalisuse ja riskide analüüsi eesmärk on selgitada välja veebilehe potentsiaalsed turvariskid ja anda soovitusi nende maandamiseks. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. ip_data_security.text: nboarding the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) to the National Eye Institute’s (NEI) existing OpenSpecimen biobanking software instance and implementing associated Electronic Medical Record (EMR) integration services. Competition is restricted to Krishagni LLC because NHLBI’s requirement is specifically to onboard to NEI’s active, Krishagni-licensed and operated OpenSpecimen environment rather than to procure a separate standalone biobanking system. Acquiring a different biobanking product would not satisfy the requirement to join the existing NEI shared instance and would result in substantial duplication of software licensing, implementation, validation, and support infrastructure costs, as well as unacceptable operational delays. As the software developer, proprietor, and operator of the existing NEI OpenSpecimen environment, Krishagni LLC is the only responsible source authorized and technically capable of performing the required onboarding, workflow configuration, and EMR integration services within that shared platform. Ukraine and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (hereinafter referred to as the “IBRD” or the “World Bank”) signed Loan Agreement No. 9238-UA in the amount of USD 200 million to implement the Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project (hereinafter referred to as the “Project”). The Project is implemented in Ukraine by the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine (MoES) with support from the World Bank Group. The Project implementation period is 2021–2027.

The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve efficiency, enhance conditions for quality assurance, and strengthen transparency in Ukraine’s higher education system.

The objective of this assignment is to ensure the systematic production of modern, high-quality video content about Ukrainian higher education, science, and innovation for the official communication channels of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine.

The Consultant will be contracted through competitive selection in line with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”).
